attchmntText: Century Extrusions Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Century Extrusions Limited published the extract of its standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2026. The publication appeared in Financial Express English editions and Duranta Barta Kolkata Bengali edition on 15th November, 2026. This filing follows the company letter dated 14th November, 2026. The announcement serves as information for BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited. Rajan Singh, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication. The document includes the company registered office address in Kolkata and corporate office address in New Delhi. Scrip code 500083 and symbol CENTEXT EQ are referenced. No financial figures or voting results are included in this specific notice.

attchmntText: Century Extrusions Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Century Extrusions Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November 2026. The Board approved and took on record the Standalone Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half year ended on 30th September 2026. The announcement also includes the Statement of Assets and Liabilities as at 30th September 2026 and the Cash Flow Statement for the Half year ended on 30th September 2026. These documents are accompanied by a Limited Review Report for the Quarter and Half year ended on 30th September 2026. The meeting commenced at 11:00 A.M. and concluded at 03:50 P.M. This information is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations.
